# Kaliora Management & Consulting
# https://www.kalioraltd.com

## About

Kaliora Management & Consulting is a founder-led management consulting firm based in Plovdiv, Bulgaria. The firm is led by Georgi Kalaydzhiev, who brings over 20 years of senior operational leadership across Central and Eastern Europe.

## What Kaliora Does

Kaliora helps business owners and investors improve operational performance, fix what isn't working, structure commercial deals, and build new ventures. Each engagement is personally led by Georgi Kalaydzhiev and supported by selected external expertise when the project requires it.

## Services

- Operations & Management Advisory
- Retail & Shopping Centre Management
- Entertainment & Hospitality Operations
- Deal Structuring & Commercial Negotiations
- New Venture Development & Launch
- Financial Modelling (IRR, NPV, EBITDA, FCF)
- 360° Business Diagnostic

## 360° Business Diagnostic

The flagship service. A structured 14-day diagnostic review covering operations, financial performance, marketing effectiveness and organisational capability. Delivers a Critical Points Report, Quick Wins list, ROI model and 6-month action plan.

## Case Studies

- Kaboom SoftPlay Park (Ruse, Bulgaria) — greenfield FEC project from concept to operational launch
- Multi-site Operations Transformation — 18% cost reduction, 12% EBITDA improvement, €1.2M annual savings across a €50M+ portfolio in CEE
